description: This PHP class 'EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel' is part of an HRM system and models the allowed languages for an employee, including serialization logic and interaction with employee language services.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel
classes.description: A model representing the languages allowed for an employee, including serialization logic to output allowed languages with fluency options.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the employee's language data into an array, including available fluency options that are not already used by the employee.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the EmployeeLanguageService instance used to fetch employee language data.
